scope: First flight wingbeat loop16only; no takeoff/landing/path/Core implementation
requiredRuntimeLocation: src/client/render/character-motion.ts currently lacks flight in motionNames/motionDurations/priority; atlas CharDef uses this MotionName. Parent must add deliberate flight support before applying authoring fragment.
anchorKind: Stable airborne breast/body-centre; separate from ground/feet projection
altitude: The renderer must supply actual world flight altitude and projected ground/shadow position separately. Do not infer height from current wingtip or body anchor, or give the sprite a fake baked shadow.
logicalTile: 16worldpx grid; full open-wing source is up to20.955px wide. Allow actual overhang, do not clip to a16px cell, shrink each phase to fit, or enlarge the body to disguise a frame mismatch.
nearestSampling: Current MapRenderer TextureStyle default is nearest. First original has only2px silhouette separation in a rear pair and exact1px margins. Do not enlarge rectangles or replace nearest with filtered atlas sampling without re-review.
runtimeGate: Select only while the core/presentation truth says the same crow is actually airborne and has sufficient functioning wings/flight capacity. Standing/hopping/work/eye-peck must retain their own clips.
coreOwned: finite flight paths and valid destinations
gameTime: Wingbeat400ms is presentation only; it does not grant movement distance, TU, free energy, immune height, food or AI knowledge.
transitions: Takeoff and landing have not been drawn in this first-pass bundle. Do not call an existing idle frame a newly completed takeoff/landing sequence. Parent controls interruptions/failed flight/fall/death and ground-mode recovery.
